# Rating (`rating`)

Star rating, read-only or editable.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createRating` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/rating.d.ts`): `.mh-rating`: a row of stars. Editable (`--editable`) it is a radio group, one native radio per star, so arrow keys move and Tab enters on the chosen star; pointer hover previews the choice, and choosing the current star again clears it. Read-only (`--readonly`) it is one `role="img"` with the value spoken ("3.5 out of 5 stars") and stars filled to fractions. Each star's fill is drawn from `--_fill` (0 to 1).

```ts
export function createRating(options: RatingOptions): RatingHandle;

export interface RatingOptions {
  /** Accessible name ("Rating", "How was it?"). */
  label: string;
  /** 0 is unrated. Read-only ratings may be fractional (3.5). */
  value?: number;
  /** Number of stars. Default 5. */
  max?: number;
  /** Shows the value without taking input. */
  readOnly?: boolean;
  /** Choosing the current value again clears it to 0. Default true. */
  allowClear?: boolean;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';
  /** Filled colour: the theme accent (default) or the warning amber. */
  tone?: RatingTone;
  /** Filled and empty icons. Default `star` and `star-outline`. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  emptyIcon?: IconName | string;
  /** The spoken name of one choice. Default "1 star", "2 stars". */
  itemLabel?: (n: number, max: number) => string;
  /** The spoken value of a read-only rating. Default "3.5 out of 5 stars". */
  valueText?: (value: number, max: number) => string;
  name?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (value: number, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface RatingHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** The radios of an editable rating (empty when read-only). */
  inputs: HTMLInputElement[];
  getValue(): number;
  setValue(value: number): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createRating } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const rating = createRating({
  label: 'How was the film?',
  value: 4,
  // Choosing the current star again clears the rating to 0.
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = value ? `You gave it ${value} of 5` : 'Not rated'),
});

document.body.append(rating.el, status);
```
